name: vibe-verifier-qae-browser
description: The browser toolchain the QAE harness drives: playwright-mcp and the Playwright build it pins. Installed with npm ci from the lockfile, so every tarball's integrity is fixed here, not resolved by the registry on each run.

allowInDependencies.@playwright/mcp: this package is the QAE harness's pinned browser toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the harness's npm ci
allowInDependencies.playwright: this package is the QAE harness's pinned browser toolchain: running it is its only job, installed by the harness's npm ci
